page.overview:
Who is Adam Neramani?

He was mentioned by Celeste Cuckoo when after she and her sister's read the mind of Tempus.

Tempus wanted to go back in time to warn Professor X about erasing Malloy from existence so it would undo the damage that he had caused. Celeste said that was the worst idea the X-Men ever had which included the existence of Adam-X.
